bridge.purpose: Rig-validity comparison with the saved AIME 2025 screen.

mechanics.purpose: Exact cue position, row-state survival, natural close, answer cap, preemption observation.

graphs.purpose: Compare exact cue positions and token IDs; graphs are enabled only if outputs match.

throughput.purpose: Choose the main concurrency and N; full 4-seed design needs about 1500 output tokens/s.

contract.purpose: Select the answer contract; legacy is the fallback.

slope.purpose: Pool-level go/no-go plus a 24-item main-cohort preview.

calibration.purpose: Choose the arrival rate and freeze the trace; tune load, not the deadline.
